pos.personaBrief: Coaches' Voice shows patient build-up and possession dominance in 2021, but Perfil/Yahoo and Scaloni himself describe giving the ball away at times and shifting by opponent.

pro.personaBrief: Argentina builds patiently with centre-backs splitting and a midfielder dropping, using short passes under pressure, but strikes direct to free runners.

est.personaBrief: Messi is given freedom to drift, wide midfielders move infield and shapes shift per opponent, with tight combinations through the middle.

lar.personaBrief: Narrow midfields (4-4-2, 4-3-1-2, extra midfielder vs Croatia) with no traditional wingers; full-backs provide width.

blo.personaBrief: Coaches' Voice: aggressive press upon losses, forwards press centre-backs, recovery in 3-5 seconds; lower block only occasionally.

mar.personaBrief: Man-oriented 1v1 defending from the lower block compared with Bielsa, number-by-number matchups in the 2022 final, zonal only on corners.

pla.personaBrief: Shuffled system for each knockout opponent at the 2022 World Cup, pragmatic chameleon, but adjusts to available players rather than imposing a model.

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic midpoint between beauty and winning; set up to win, team that never gives up, changes for results.

sis.personaBrief: Squad built to let Messi play freely; Messi walks out of possession and Di Maria excused from defending in the final, yet a collective system supports them.

jog.personaBrief: Intense pressing and running midfielders (Gonzalez, De Paul, Enzo) with a technical Messi given freedom; quality on the ball valued.

bas.personaBrief: Rejuvenated the squad with young players like Enzo, Mac Allister and Julian while keeping Messi and Di Maria; national team has no academy.

lid.personaBrief: Close dialogue with players, explains decisions, no cracks in the group; Messi untouchable and listened to, though the coach decides.
